defensives.name: Blazing Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Put it up before the pull and re-cast it as soon as the absorb breaks.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a big hit and press it again to snap back to your old health, or double-tap it with Time Walk to bank an emergency Shimmer.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to shed threat or cut a heavy damage window you cannot heal through.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it right before the pull to help your tank hold threat, and use it in combat when you need the damage reduction.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a hit that would kill you or a debuff you must clear, and cancel it the moment the danger passes.
